evidence.claim_supported: The maintainer requested the hosted v0.2.0 scope, 30-day Pro access, prices, collaboration, API/MCP/skills, and explicit exclusions.
The accepted current product is one local owner with no login, remote access, or collaboration.
Current requirements explicitly defer accounts, invitations, roles, assignment, and remote access to separate Discovery.
Firebase Authentication supports Google account sign-in for JavaScript web applications.
Firestore Security Rules can combine authenticated user IDs and stored roles for collaborative reads, writes, and comments.
Firestore supports atomic transactions and batched writes.
Firebase App Hosting requires Blaze and exposes variable compute, bandwidth, build, logging, secret, and storage costs after allowances.
Firestore charges depend on document and index reads, writes, deletes, storage, and network usage.
The maintained Stripe/Firebase extension supports checkout, subscription, customer, and webhook-backed billing workflows.
The current MCP specification defines authorization behavior for HTTP-based transports.
The current MCP remote transport uses Streamable HTTP with protocol-version and request metadata requirements.
MCP tools use JSON Schemas and require input validation, access controls, rate limits, sanitized output, and audit-aware clients/servers.
OpenAPI 3.1.1 provides a standard language-independent HTTP API description.
Linear's official page displayed a free plan and paid per-user plans above the maintainer's v0.2.0 price when observed.
Plane's official page displayed free and paid per-seat plans above the maintainer's v0.2.0 monthly price when observed.
The current repository implements a local Node/SQLite implicit-owner product and contains no supported hosted multi-user authority.

external_research.rationale: Official vendor and specification sources were observed on 2026-08-24; time-sensitive pages must be refreshed at release review.

questions.gap: No hosted-product interviews or production cohort exist; T-VALIDATE-PRICING and first UAT own the gap.

tasks.description: Test trial, active-seat, annual-discount, and Free-fallback comprehension with five target owners and model unit economics at the maintainer-confirmed prices.
tasks.deliverable: Decision memo recommending keep, change, or stop without silently changing maintainer intent.

tasks.description: Validate scoped personal-token lifecycle and compatibility for the remote REST/MCP boundary against the current MCP authorization and transport specifications.
tasks.deliverable: Threat model, compatibility matrix, and go/no-go recommendation for the v0.2.0 token bridge.

tasks.description: Define eligible new-owner activation events and measure the first mature hosted cohort.
tasks.measurement_method: Cohort query from verified auth, workspace, project, and issue creation events.
tasks.data_source: Versioned product event ledger in Firebase/analytics export.
tasks.deliverable: Dated activation baseline with exclusions, numerator, denominator, and query digest.

tasks.description: Define and measure the first mature invite-to-collaboration cohort.
tasks.measurement_method: Workspace cohort query joining invite acceptance, membership, assignment action, and non-owner comment events within seven days.
tasks.data_source: Versioned product event ledger and authoritative workspace records.
tasks.deliverable: Dated collaboration-loop baseline with exclusions and query digest.

tasks.description: Measure conversion and variable cost for eligible trials ending in the first mature billing window.
tasks.measurement_method: Cohort query joining trusted trial, Stripe subscription, seat, revenue, and Firebase usage records.
tasks.data_source: Server-owned entitlement ledger, Stripe readback, and Firebase billing export.
tasks.deliverable: Dated conversion baseline and cost-per-paid-seat report with reconciliation digest.

tasks.description: Run the canonical PM operation matrix through both REST and MCP and measure correct completion.
tasks.measurement_method: Deterministic UAT matrix with identical seeded workspaces and expected structured results.
tasks.data_source: API/MCP audit records, test results, and cross-workspace security suite.
tasks.deliverable: Dated automation reliability baseline with failure taxonomy and security guardrail result.

outcomes.subject: target_user
outcomes.expected_change: complete the first useful planning action shortly after Google sign-in

metric.name: ten-minute hosted activation rate
metric.definition: share of eligible first-time owners who complete Google sign-in, workspace bootstrap, project creation, and first issue creation within ten minutes
metric.population: first-time owner accounts with successful Google sign-in and no prior trial eligibility record
metric.workload: one initial hosted workspace bootstrap per eligible owner

guardrails.name: owner bootstrap error rate
guardrails.metric_definition: share of eligible owner bootstrap attempts ending in an unhandled or unrecoverable error
guardrails.source: product event ledger and error telemetry

assumptions: Google sign-in availability is not the dominant failure mode
the provisional observation window follows a usable release

outcomes.subject: target_user
outcomes.target_segment_or_system: eligible trial workspaces with at least one sent invitation
outcomes.expected_change: complete a durable owner-to-member collaboration loop

metric.name: seven-day collaboration-loop completion rate
metric.definition: share of eligible workspaces with one accepted invite, one non-owner action on an assigned issue, and one non-owner comment within seven days of the first invite
metric.population: trial workspaces sending their first valid member invitation
metric.workload: one first invitation and resulting assigned-work loop per workspace

measurement.source: authoritative workspace and product event ledger

guardrails.name: unwanted or duplicate accepted membership rate
guardrails.metric_definition: share of accepted memberships created without one valid intended invitation and matching signed-in email

assumptions: one assignee and two roles cover the first collaboration loop
the provisional observation window follows a usable release

outcomes.subject: target_user
outcomes.target_segment_or_system: eligible workspace owners whose 30-day Pro trial ends
outcomes.expected_change: choose and maintain a paid hosted subscription at the maintainer-confirmed price

metric.name: seven-day trial-to-paid conversion rate
metric.definition: share of eligible workspaces activating a paid monthly or annual subscription within seven days after the 30-day trial ends
metric.population: non-abusive workspaces completing a first 30-day Pro trial during the window
metric.workload: one trial-expiry and subscription decision per eligible workspace

measurement.source: server-owned entitlement ledger and verified Stripe readback

guardrails.name: variable service cost share
guardrails.metric_definition: Firebase, payment processing, and directly attributable hosted variable costs divided by recognized subscription revenue for the cohort
guardrails.source: Firebase billing export and Stripe balance/revenue records

assumptions: USD before applicable taxes is acceptable for launch
one-user Free fallback avoids coercive data loss

outcomes.subject: system
outcomes.target_segment_or_system: versioned BasicLinear REST and MCP product-management surfaces
outcomes.expected_change: complete canonical PM operations correctly and safely through either automation surface

metric.name: canonical automation task success rate
metric.definition: share of canonical project, milestone, issue, assignment, comment, membership, and read-only billing tasks returning the expected durable state through both REST and MCP without manual repair
metric.workload: one deterministic run per task through REST and MCP for owner and member roles

measurement.source: API/MCP structured results, audit ledger, and authoritative Firestore readback

guardrails.name: successful cross-workspace unauthorized operations
guardrails.metric_definition: count of unauthorized cross-workspace reads or mutations that return protected data or change protected state
guardrails.source: cross-workspace security suite and audit ledger

assumptions: the provisional observation window follows an implementation candidate
